name: Owner enters the two password factors
description: Verifies the owner can enter both configured password factors and reach the private console.
steps: Open the discreet owner panel from the crown icon
Submit it and enter the configured second password
expected: The private owner console opens and shows the ANIL executive assistant.

name: Owner manages ANIL permissions and approval queue
description: Verifies the owner can control safe autonomous permissions and see sensitive changes routed into an approval queue.
steps: Turn one autonomous permission off and on again
expected: The permission state changes, while the price change is represented as a pending approval rather than silently changing the live price.

name: Customer gets an AI Council route
description: Verifies a customer request reaches the live AI planning route and returns a useful rendered plan without exposing provider secrets.
steps: Enter a request such as 'I need a website for my business'
expected: A useful ANIL X route is rendered and the UI does not display any API key or secret.

name: Owner can execute an allowed public messaging improvement
description: Verifies an allowed public-copy update can be executed and audited.
steps: Ask ANIL to improve the public homepage message
Review the response and then refresh the console
expected: ANIL either applies the allowed messaging change and reports success, or records that the corresponding permission is disabled.

name: Invalid owner password does not open the console
description: Verifies an incorrect first password cannot reach the private executive console.
expected: An authentication error is shown and the private console remains locked.
